claims.claim_text: The indexed Harold L. Berg is Harold Lincoln Berg, the second lieutenant listed by the Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency as lost in Burma on December 18, 1944.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official accounting list matches the index's name, second-lieutenant rank, and private officer identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private-identifier match plus full name and rank across two official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The accounting record dates his loss during OSS service; it does not by itself document his pre-service employer.
claims.match_notes: The full officer identifier remains private. The local memorial independently supplies his middle name and OSS Detachment 101 context.

claims.claim_text: Border Publishing in International Falls is the best-supported last civilian employer currently identified for Harold L. Berg before Army and OSS service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: He listed his employer as Don Chase, Border Publishing in International Falls.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The memorial biography reports Berg's 1940 draft-registration employer and describes his newspaper circulation-management work.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The biography's full name, rank, hometown, Burma loss date, and OSS Detachment 101 service align with the confirmed official identity.
claims.temporal_assessment: Probable last civilian employer in October 1940; no reviewed source yet excludes an intervening job before Army entry.
claims.match_notes: The claim remains qualified until the underlying draft-registration image or personnel file is reviewed.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private-identifier and full-name match across three records.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army entry is dated October 24, 1942; no individual OSS transfer date is present.
